intro: Marshal Haggard, a retired officer living in eastern Elwynn Forest, was tricked into surrendering his official insignia to a Defias rogue named Dead-tooth Jack. Jack disguised himself in a Stormwind tabard in the dark to pose as Marshal Dughan and steal the badge. Haggard needs the badge recovered before the Defias Brotherhood can use it to impersonate Stormwind officials.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Burlguard sent you, did he? Yes, I have spare weapons around here, but first I have a task for you...

A while ago a Defias villain Dead-tooth Jack tricked me. It was dark and he was wearing a Stormwind tabard and I thought he was Marshal Dughan. He said he needed my old Stormwind Marshal's badge and I gave it to him... And then he laughed and ran off before I could catch him!
Get back my badge! Dead-tooth Jack probably has it stowed in his camp to the south.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have my badge? I don't want to think of the mischief Dead-tooth Jack could cause with it.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Great, you found it! I feared it was gone forever, used by the Defias to impersonate a Stormwind official. Well that won't happen now, thanks to you.
Here are some weapons I used when I was a Marshal. I kept them in great shape--take your pick!
